description: d3d9 implementation the exports forward to: dxvk (stock DXVK, pinned by proxy/tools/fetch_dxvk.py) or system (the Windows d3d9); a missing DXVK falls back to system with a warning
DXVK d3d9 DLL, relative to the game folder or absolute; DXVK log, config and caches are redirected next to it (never the game folder)
0 = pure pass-through: the backend only (no exe guard, no crash capture, no patches); for isolating a problem to the proxy
exe-identity guard: 1 = an exe that is not the pinned build runs as plain pass-through; 0 = developer override, engine features on whatever the exe (warned at every start)
test key: 1 = take the pass-through path on a matching exe (notice file and log as for a real mismatch); wins over exe_guard=0
lowest level written to napoleon_remastered\logs\proxy.log: debug, info, warn or error

in-process minidump into napoleon_remastered\dumps: 0 off, 1 unhandled exceptions only, 2 also the first fatal first-chance exception (when the game replaces the top-level filter); WER LocalDumps is the out-of-process backstop
runtime patch engine: apply the engine_sites patches in memory once the exe guard accepts the exe (all-or-nothing); 0 = check and log only
